purpose: Engineering acceptance budgets on a declared reference machine, not universal library SLOs or claims about incremental/native implementations. Do not relax after selecting a backend without recording a decision in #156.
update_contract: Insert and support-removing delete are complete rematerializations from authoritative input, not incremental propagation or persistent publication. Future executors must validate identical answers and separately label insertion/deletion/maintenance modes.
measurement_contract: Fresh processes, PYTHONHASHSEED=0, OMP/Polars threads=1. Include existing package import in cold worker time; pipeline includes compilation, conversion, execution and decode but excludes fixture construction, import and validation. RSS is full worker high-water mark; no subtraction of startup high-water. Report median and nearest-rank p95, phase times, environment and source footprint. Missing metrics/dependencies, timeouts or wrong answers fail, not pass.
future_required_measurements: incremental support/retraction P50/P95 and write amplification
